metadata.description: Claude Cowork Bootcamp — skills, connectors, and workflows for knowledge workers

plugins.name: system-prompt-settings
plugins.description: One-time system prompt setup for Claude Cowork

plugins.name: business-blueprint
plugins.description: Interactive interview that builds a personalized agent config and CLAUDE.md so the agent knows who you are, what your business does, and how to help you

plugins.name: organize-machine
plugins.description: Organize files on your computer using GTD principles — starts with screenshots, expands to your whole desktop and downloads

plugins.name: notion-connector
plugins.description: Connect Claude Cowork to your Notion workspace so skills can read your notes and create pages directly where you work

plugins.name: voice-training
plugins.description: Train your agent on your unique writing voice using your past writing so all outputs sound like you, not generic AI

plugins.name: newsletter-writer
plugins.description: Draft your weekly newsletter by pulling from your Notion notes, writing in your voice, and saving the finished draft directly to Notion

plugins.name: social-content
plugins.description: Generate social media posts for X and LinkedIn in your voice from topics, notes, or ideas

plugins.name: trend-jacking
plugins.description: Research trending topics in your industry and generate content angles with draft posts you can publish immediately

plugins.name: voice-memo-to-post
plugins.description: Turn voice memos, rough notes, and dictated ideas into polished social media posts in your voice

plugins.name: gmail-connector
plugins.description: Connect Gmail to Cowork and triage your inbox — read emails, draft replies, and pull inbox context into other skills

plugins.name: slack-connector
plugins.description: Connect Slack to Cowork and catch up on channels — read channels, summarize threads, and pull conversation context into other skills

plugins.name: google-docs-connector
plugins.description: Connect Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets to Cowork for reading, writing, and pulling file context into other skills

plugins.name: fireflies-connector
plugins.description: Connect Fireflies.ai to Cowork for meeting transcripts, action items, and past conversation context

plugins.name: meeting-prep
plugins.description: Prepare a comprehensive brief before any meeting by pulling from Gmail, Slack, Google Docs, and Fireflies

plugins.name: gamma-connector
plugins.description: Connect Gamma to Cowork for creating presentations, documents, and webpages from your content

plugins.name: gamma-designer
plugins.description: Turn content into polished Gamma presentations, one-pagers, and documents

plugins.name: project-kit
plugins.description: Generate a complete project kit from a single input — meeting transcript, brief, or voice memo becomes a proposal, presentation, social posts, and follow-up email

plugins.name: vercel-landing-page
plugins.description: Build and deploy a landing page to Vercel from a description, Notion content, or product brief

plugins.name: browser-automation
plugins.description: Automate repetitive browser tasks — fill forms, navigate websites, extract data, and interact with web tools on your behalf

plugins.name: skill-maker
plugins.description: Build new custom skills from scratch based on your business context — turn manual processes into repeatable agent skills

plugins.name: digital-product
plugins.description: Build a digital product from idea to launch using the 0 to $1 framework

plugins.name: ship30-tutor
plugins.description: Ship 30 for 30 agent tutor — teaches the atomic essay system lesson by lesson, builds your idea matrix, and creates Notion templates for daily writing

plugins.name: cnc
plugins.description: Category Newsletter Creator — complete newsletter business system with tutor (learn the course), builder (create the assets), and smart routing. Covers positioning, writing, growth, monetization, email automation, and book publishing across 6 tracks

plugins.name: ltl-tutor
plugins.description: Low Ticket Launchpad — build, price, and launch your low-ticket digital product ($50-$350) with interactive exercises, progress tracking, and a builder that helps you create every asset
